alarms.action: Conveyor motor stops and alarm remains latched until fault reset (PB-0002 / X1)
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
alarms.name: Jam alarm

alarms.action: Conveyor motor stops immediately and alarm flag M191 sets
alarms.condition: Motor overload contact MOL-1001 opens (X13 low)
alarms.name: Motor overload alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: 5.0 s (entry photo-eye PE-1002 blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs)
conflicts.program_says: Not implemented (T10 timer and PE-1002 logic are omitted from program)

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain open / not healthy (ES-0001 / X0 low)
Auto mode not selected (SS-0003 / X2 low)
Stopper release request (RQ-1005 / X14) rising edge
interlocks.effect: Energize stopper solenoid (XY-1004 / Y11) for 2.0 s

steps.entry: Auto mode selected (SS-0003 / X2) with no ST10 fault present (MOL-1001 clear, jam clear) and E-stop chain healthy (ES-0001 / X0)
steps.exit: Motor overload trip, jam alarm trip, auto mode switched off, or E-stop chain broken
steps.name: Conveyor Run

steps.entry: Pallet arrives against spring stopper and makes at-stop photo-eye PE-1001 (X10)
steps.exit: Stopper release request received from line controller
steps.name: Pallet Hold

steps.entry: Release request rising edge (RQ-1005 / X14) received from line controller
steps.name: Stopper Release
